mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at 65 degrees at Verona Community Park with an air quality index of 52. The moon is in its first quarter phase, and the International Space Station will make a brief appearance tonight at 3:23 AM, rising in the south over Belleville and traveling east toward Fitchburg, remaining low near the horizon.

The city is hiring an Engineering Technician to help manage municipal construction projects, and the common council has approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to keep our systems self-supporting.

We have plenty of local excitement including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.

In a noteworthy call for service on Friday, August 15, officers responded to a report of a missing 7-year-old in the Westridge Estates neighborhood, who was fortunately found and safely reunited with their parents.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open tomorrow at 10 AM.
